# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c25 P46](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0046), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye is fat and has a sharp appearance. She wears dresses with flounces and evening dresses, and once dressed pompadoured and frilled.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008), [v1 c34 P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v2 c14 P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

## Personality

Josie is defiant, malicious, and possesses little imagination. Known as the sharpest-tongued student at Queen's Academy, she is sulky when she does not get her way and delights in making disagreeable or pitying remarks to others. Despite her flaws, she has a natural and cultivated skill for walking board fences.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

## History

Josie Pye attended Avonlea school, where she frequently clashed with Anne Shirley and other classmates. During a game, after successfully walking a board fence, she dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, resulting in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Josie joined the Queen's class organized by Miss Stacy, scraped through the entrance examinations, and went on to attend Queen's Academy in Charlottetown. While attending Queen's, she boarded at the same place as Frank Stockley and was known as the sharpest-tongued young lady in attendance. After completing her first year, she returned to Queen's for further education rather than teaching. Later, her home was the venue for a farewell party hosted by the A.V.I.S. in honor of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe prior to their departure for college.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P37](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0037), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001)_
